IL.rule: The highest price per acre among bare farmland sales of 40 acres or more (no buildings, not forest) recorded in Illinois in the 30 days to Oct 30, 2026, the newest on file. Only farm ground counts: the county needs at least 5 bare farmland sales of 20 acres or more over 24 months to compare with, a county whose middle price is more than twice the state's ($10,600 an acre) is left out as town or development ground, and so is any sale priced at more than twice the state's middle. Sales far outside their county's usual range are left out too; they are on the monthly page. Fewer than 3 such sales: no sale shown.
